useWhen: Install as a Bot (Itonami profile) or as a Hermes profile: kotobase 担当。データベース(kotobase-engine/storage 系)、Cloudflare Workers、net-kotobase(kotobase.net)を含む kotobase 系の保守・開発・デプロイ。
avoidWhen: Expecting credentials, accounts, memories or an enabled schedule to come with it.

inputs.owner: the installing organization binds accounts and grants

outputs.profile: Hermes profile files at the pinned commit

authority.binding: The installing owner rebinds accounts, connector grants, wallet signer and approval policy; cron arrives disabled.

compatibilityNote: Itonami profile = Hermes profile layout. Files stay in the owning repository at the pinned commit; verify the tree checksum before use.
